name: Bilel Chegrani
bio: Bilel Chegrani is an actor, known for French Touch: Between Men (2019), Fragile and Cuties (2020).

credits.title: The Daughters of Abraham
credits.overview: After several years apart, Myriam, a young woman from a Muslim background who grew up in Marseille, reconnects with Eva, who comes from a Jewish family, during the summer vacation. Together, they live out their youth outside the imposed norms. But this carefree summer begins to unravel when a tragedy upends the balance

credits.title: L'Autre
credits.overview: Bedridden following a severe cancer, a man sees his recovery falter when his young roommate begins to stir up his deepest fears.

credits.title: Kraken
credits.overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

credits.title: The Girls From Above
credits.overview: Héloïse has nowhere to go. She meets Mallorie, who offers to let her stay in the flat she shares with two other young women. Héloïse finds a new home and a new family there. But their past wounds threaten the fragile balance between these women who appear so strong on the surface.

credits.title: Nice Human
credits.overview: Lyès is a young immigrant who works as a rider and delivery man without ever stopping. Exhausted by sleep deprivation and homesickness, he wants to complete his last delivery, even after an accident.

credits.title: Le jour où un zèbre devint tigre
And Their Children After Them
credits.overview: In eastern France, two teenage cousins have the summer of their lives when they paddle a purloined canoe to the far shore of a lake.

credits.title: Genealogy of Violence
credits.overview: A young couple sits in a car when two policemen pull up to command a routine identity check. They ask the man to get out and proceed methodically with a pat-down, as he stands in front of the car, watched by his dismayed girlfriend.

credits.title: MadS
credits.overview: A teenager stops off to see his dealer to test a new drug before heading off for a night of partying. On the way home, he picks up an injured woman, and the night takes a surreal turn.

credits.title: Drone
credits.overview: Émilie lives in a world of surveillance: her camgirl work; the camera phone lingering on a crush from afar; the headset affording her a drone’s perspective. credits.title: American Boy
credits.overview: Malik spends his days trying to get attention from others with empty, boring chats. One day, he catches the attention of one guy with a lie, saying that he's going to the US to study cinema. The news quickly goes around the neighborhood and Malik suddenly becomes everyones’s hope and pride.

credits.title: The Gravity
credits.overview: As a mysterious planetary alignment sets the sky on fire, two brothers are reunited with a childhood friend.

credits.title: Yarayah
credits.overview: The story of Yasmina, a Algerian and French female bodybuilder who goes back home after winning the world championship at the Arnold classic. This story depicts the moment in which Yasmina has to face her father's closed doors.

credits.title: Little Ones
credits.overview: Camille a 16 years old pregnant girl was placed in a maternal center by the Judge. She became friends with Alison, an immature young mother, and fought against the authority of Nadine, an educator as passionate as she was disillusioned.

credits.title: Dog Hearts
credits.overview: It's the end of the afternoon, Ana and Océane, both seventeen years old, are waiting in front of their small local movie theater. credits.title: Arthur Rambo
credits.overview: Who is this Karim D. ? The new young writer whom the media can't get enough of? Or his alias, Arthur Rambo, the author of old hate-fuellled messages which are dredged up, one day, from social media websites?

credits.title: Hot Rod
credits.overview: Summer 2031, 104°. Saadia, 16, is in mechanical school although the car industry is in crisis and there are only a few electric cars in circulation. Her friends, Charly and Titi, throw a joke to cheer her up: what if the car of the future was a horse? Against all odds, Saadia trades her scooter for a massive workhorse

credits.title: Va dans les bois
credits.overview: Maria takes care of her father's sled dogs and watches clips of teenagers skateboarding in L.A. One night, she follows Vincent - the guy who puts up the tiles on the front of her house - to the trailer where he lives. She then finds herself embroiled in some strange business...

credits.title: Hard Shell, Soft Shell
credits.overview: Az works for an oyster farmer in Sète. He knows oysters by heart, he opens them by the hundreds. In one of them, Az decides to hide a ring, to ask his girlfriend Jess to marry him. She doesn't say yes. Fortunately, his band of friends are ready to do anything to help him get his head out of the water.

credits.title: Palme
credits.overview: Bilal and his friends spend their summer fishing and hanging out on the banks of the Seine. Bilal is not a fisherman, not a gambler, not a flirt. Everything will change for him when he sees a strange, naked female creature passing through the water. Bilal then searches for her tirelessly.

credits.title: Cuties
credits.overview: Amy, an 11-year-old girl, joins a group of dancers named “the cuties” at school, and rapidly grows aware of her burgeoning femininity—upsetting her mother and her values in the process.

credits.title: French Touch: Between Men
credits.overview: Between life, between love, between men. Four stories of men facing the precipice of deep change in their lives... and the male figures that took them there. credits.title: Ahmed's Song
credits.overview: One day Ahmed, employed at the public baths and nearing retirement, encounters Mike, a teenager adrift. Inside the bathhouse walls, a strange relationship will develop between these two fractured souls.

credits.title: Bye Bye les puceaux
credits.overview: Even though they don’t know each other very much, Inès (14) and Abdel (15) decide to have their first time together. The big day arrives and Inès is called to help out a neighbor to babysit her two kids Moussa (3) and Balla (5). Inès is determined to go through with their plan and asks Abdel to join her at her neighbor

credits.title: Gardiennes
credits.overview: Acha and Myriam, fifteen years old, are bored out of their skulls in their social housing project. Sam, the leader of a gang of boys, asks them to be gardiennes for him. Honored, they stand in front of the main entrance of Building C, convinced they are participating in exciting drug deals.

credits.title: Taste of Love
credits.overview: After an ambiguous Snapchat video featuring Bilel and Adil, rumors start spreading about the two friends. To save their reputation, each of them tries to find a girlfriend. Their hunt for a date doesn’t quite go as expected.

credits.title: 1000 Faces
credits.overview: Four first short films by young filmmakers. An initiative by director Houda Benyamina, produced by her association "1000 visages" (1000 faces).
